units.spine: The Free Elder Council asks little of Warmholz, and even that goes unanswered.
A traveller who asks the Free Elder Council for a decision at Warmholz finds it made somewhere else entirely, by whoever the town actually listens to.

units.poolKey: no token matched: unclassified (the plain-description floor)
units.spine: The Free Elder Council governs Warmholz, and the town's affairs run through it.

units.poolKey: capture pressure ADVANCING (weak security, poor prosperity)
units.spine: The criminal interest at Warmholz has not reached where the town's decisions get made, not yet. The pay is thin and the watch is thinner, and a town bought that cheaply rarely knows it until after.
A decision does not leave the Free Elder Council at Warmholz until every voice on it can live with it, and once it leaves, it rarely comes back for a second look.

units.poolKey: governing body name: a SLOT, never a baked noun
units.spine: A drover at Warmholz who calls the Free Elder Council by any other name is corrected before the sentence is finished.
Around Warmholz the talk is that the Free Elder Council does not really run the place anymore, and watching it govern, it is hard to say the council believes otherwise.

units.poolKey: legitimacyHold: public rejection is breaking the hold
units.spine: The Free Elder Council has lost ground at Warmholz to the town itself, not to any rival waiting to take advantage of it.
